timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: Hi, kids.  Looks like you'll have the place all to yourself.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Really?  I thought this was a busy time of year.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: It is.  Only this blasted ghost has been scaring off all my customers.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: If this keeps up, I'll be bankrupt!

timeline.speaker: Shaggy
timeline.text: G-g-ghost?

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: I knew I shouldn't have said anything.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: We don't believe in Ghosts, Uncle Blake!

timeline.speaker: Shaggy
timeline.text: Speak for yourself, Fred!

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Uncle Blake, tell us about this ghost.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: Not much to tell. He showed up about a month ago and started running me broke.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: The gardener claims he's the ghost of the Ancient Chieftan.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Who's the Ancient Chieftan?

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: A long time ago, the Indians used this place as a burial ground.

timeline.speaker: Shaggy
timeline.text: You mean like from India?

timeline.speaker: Velma
timeline.text: No, silly. He means Native Americans.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: The Ancient Chieftan was a famous warrior around these parts about two hundred years ago.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: They say he's buried nearby.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Why would the ghost of the Ancient Chieftan be haunting you?

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: I don't know for certain.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: But the gardener claims the Chieftan doesn't like his land being used for a hotel.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: What I can't figure out is how come it took so long for him to get mad about it.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Where was this ghost seen last?

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: The cook saw him across the river just yesterday.

timeline.speaker: Fred
timeline.text: Come on, guys. Let's check out that area.

timeline.speaker: Shaggy
timeline.text: Not me! I'm not going anywhere near any ghosts. I'm going to hit room service.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: Sorry, son, but the staff all quit last week.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: The only ones who stayed were the cook and the gardener.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: If you talk to the cook nicely,maybe he'll make you something to eat.

timeline.speaker: Blake
timeline.text: Let's move inside where it's warm, hmm?.
